scope: Catch-up paging for the minute-level live feeds: app/crawler/catchup.py, sina_source.fetch_sina, fastnews.fetch_cls, fastnews.fetch_wscn_live

legacy_record.source: read-only copy of the Mac legacy database (fetch_log 2026-09-18T20:07Z to 2026-10-03T16:02Z)
legacy_record.failure_causes: about 700 local DNS/network-unreachable errors (collector offline), about 10 remote timeouts
legacy_record.estimate_method: missing item ids per hour inside idle gaps minus the background rate of missing ids (ids the feed itself never lists) during normal polling

change: When none of the newest page is stored, read older pages (Sina page numbers, WSCN next_cursor, CLS roll-list last_time) until a page contains a stored item; at most 20 more pages, never older than the source's last success less 15 minutes, none for a source that never succeeded; stored items on older pages are left out; CLS older pages use the existing detail URL form

live_check.setup: throwaway database, last success set 3 hours back, nothing stored, real endpoints

cls-telegraph.note: id gaps are present within single endpoint responses (shared numbering)

wallstreetcn-live.note: id gaps are present within single endpoint responses (shared numbering)

tests: tests/test_flash_feed_catch_up.py: steady state one request, gap closed once without stored items, page shift without repeats, never-succeeded source, resume bound, page cap, failed older page reported as partial, CLS URL form, runner insertion; seven mutations each fail a test
